lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits; the mid-flank row contains a sequence of 8-10 prominent maxima with regular spatial intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at 90-degree angles, creating a grid-like pattern of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadowed fall-off on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, low-luminance features (commensal organisms) are visible attached to the ventral surface near the axilla of the pectoral fin.
